description: This file defines an abstract class for a sharded persistent actor in an Akka-based system, managing entities with snapshotting, event sourcing, command handling, and lifecycle management.

classes.name: AbstractShardedPersistenceActor
classes.description: An abstract Akka persistent actor class managing sharded entities with snapshotting and event sourcing capabilities.

classes.name: CheckForActivity
classes.description: A message class used for scheduling activity checks based on access counters.

methods.name: recoveryCompleted
methods.description: Callback invoked after recovery completes; can be overridden for additional actions.

methods.name: becomeCreatedOrDeletedHandler
methods.description: Switches actor behavior depending on whether the entity is active or deleted.

methods.name: getStrategyContext
methods.description: Returns the context used for handling commands.

methods.name: getCreatedStrategy
methods.description: Provides strategies for handling commands when the entity exists.

methods.name: getDeletedStrategy
methods.description: Provides strategies for handling commands when the entity does not exist.

methods.name: getEventStrategy
methods.description: Returns the strategy for applying events to modify the entity.

methods.name: getEntitySchemaVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version of the entity based on content.

methods.name: publishEvent
methods.description: Abstract method for publishing an event.

methods.name: getEventClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of persisted events.

methods.name: persistAndApplyEvent
methods.description: Persists an event, applies it to the entity, and executes a callback.

methods.name: takeSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the current entity state if conditions are met.

methods.name: snapshotThresholdPassed
methods.description: Checks if enough changes have accumulated to warrant a snapshot.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Applies an event to the internal handleEvents behavior and publishes it.

methods.name: notAccessible
methods.description: Handles attempts to access a nonexistent or deleted entity.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Logs shutdown info and passivates the actor.

methods.name: matchAnyAfterInitialization
methods.description: Default handler for unknown messages.

methods.name: checkForActivity
methods.description: Checks if the entity has been active; initiates shutdown or snapshot as needed.

methods.name: scheduleCheckForActivity
methods.description: Schedules an activity check after a given interval.

methods.name: scheduleSnapshot
methods.description: Schedules periodic snapshotting.

methods.name: cancelSnapshot
methods.description: Cancels scheduled snapshotting.

methods.name: handleByCommandStrategy
methods.description: Handles commands using the provided command strategy.

methods.name: getNextRevisionNumber
methods.description: Calculates the next revision number for events.

methods.name: persistEvent
methods.description: Persists an event and executes a handler upon success.

methods.name: takeSnapshotByInterval
methods.description: Triggers snapshot based on interval schedule.
